title: Postgraduate Diploma Programme
institution: The Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP)
about: ICTP's one-year Postgraduate Diploma Programme in Trieste comprises two semesters of classes followed by a research project and dissertation, in subject areas such as high energy physics, condensed matter, Earth system physics, mathematics and quantitative life sciences. Apply by 28 February 2027.
requirements: Degree equivalent to an MSc, or an exceptionally good BSc, in physics, mathematics or a related field
Generally below 28 years of age; from UN, UNESCO or IAEA member countries
